text:
02 November 2026 
 
 
 
 
   ISIN: INE0SII01026 
 
 
Dear Sir/ Ma'am,  
 
Subject: Audio recording of Earnings Conference Call on Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated 
Financial Results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015, the audio recording of the earnings conference call in respect of 
the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the Second Quarter and Half Year 
ended 30 September 2026, held today i.e. 2nd November 2026 at 12:30 p.m. (IST), is required to be 
made available on the Company’s website at https://www.qualitypower.com. 
 
Due to a technical issue on the Company’s website, the audio recording could not be uploaded 
today. The Company is taking necessary steps to resolve the issue, and the audio recording will be 
uploaded on the Company’s website as soon as the issue is resolved. The Company regrets the 
inconvenience caused. 
 
The audio recording will be made available at the following link once the technical issue is resolved: 
 
https://qualitypower.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Quality-Power-Q2FY27-Concall-
Audio.mp3 
 
Thanking You, 
 
Yours faithfully, 
 
For QUALITY POWER ELECTRICAL EQUIPMENTS LIMITED 
 
 
 
 
Deepak Ramchandra Suryavanshi 
Company Secretary and Compliance Officer
